results.title: Netanyahu Calls For National Unity Government To Counter Iran Threat, But Gadi Eisenkot Rejects Appeal, Accuses Israel’s Outgoing PM Of Playing ‘Tricks’
results.description: Israel’s caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has called for a national unity government, but political rival Gadi Eisenkot has rejected the appeal. The exchange comes as Eisenkot begins negotiations to form the next government, with disagreements over Arab parties and the role of far-right politicians complicating the process. The post Netanyahu Calls For National Unity Government To Counter Iran Threat, But Gadi Eisenkot Rejects Appeal, Accuses Israel’s Outgoing PM Of Playing ‘Tricks’ appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.
